summary: AstraZeneca furnished a 6-K reporting a routine PDMR shareholding notification under the EU Market Abuse Regulation as it forms part of UK law. On 14 September 2026, CFO Aradhana Sarin acquired 73 ordinary shares of $0.25 each via vesting of dividend equivalent awards tied to her 2021 AstraZeneca Performance Share Plan award, which initially vested 17 August 2026. Shares were withheld for tax; the reference price was 114.60 pence. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic event is involved, only an ordinary insider transaction disclosure with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
